scope.applicability: Shared meaning for the Lab-owned Define integration and its explicitly named consumers. This proposed meaning does not adopt the upstream runtime or every historical package record.
exclusions: Canonical definition admission by candidate generation.
Authority to change an external organization or production system.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: CyberAlchemy Define is the Lab capability outcome of making the meaning required for one bounded goal and its originating intent explicit for a named consumer. It identifies the declared required concepts, examines existing meanings and their source standing, exposes ambiguous or missing meaning and owner gaps, and records exactly one current disposition—reuse, specialize, propose or open—for every required concept in a reviewable Definition Pack. It preserves unresolved meaning and the intent that motivated the goal. It does not select the consumer solution, admit a Definition, assign an owner or grant execution authority. Its Product Capability instance must separately bind exactly one Product, scope, owner and outcome contract; the CLI and agent are realizations.
scientific_formal.formal_expression: Define(g,i,k,u,E) yields P with preserved goal/intent lineage, total required-concept handling, visible residue and no new admission/action authority from preparation. Capability meaning, its Product Capability instance, Method contract, CLI realization, Pack and owner Decision answer distinct declared questions; their labels alone are not a non-collapse proof.

notation.meaning: Bounded goal, originating intent, declared context, named consumer/use and selected evidence standing.
One reviewable Definition Pack; its closed contract defines required concept coverage and unresolved obligations.
Each declared required concept receives one current reuse, specialize, propose or open disposition; this is not proof that every relevant concept was discovered.
No new semantic promotion or permission is created by preparation; exact existing meanings retain their separate authority.

boundary_conditions: The capability outcome does not select the human, machine agent, command, workflow or component used to realize it.
Newly discovered requirements may revise the goal or required concept set explicitly; prior intent and revisions remain traceable.
An open disposition is a legitimate recorded result. It may block a named next use without preventing review of the gap.
Existing authoritative meanings keep their exact source posture; newly generated language remains candidate.
Define may prepare a consumer input, but consumer suitability, conformance, owner admission and permission remain separate decisions.

A durable Define work-session record is not durable machine-agent identity or private long-term agent memory. Machine sessions remain ephemeral and obtain durable context from Project State and views.
testable_conditions: The output goal remains traceable to its originating intent; no implementation convenience silently replaces it.
Every concept declared required in the resulting pack has exactly one handling disposition.
An unanswered question remains visible without a fabricated user answer or semantic-owner decision.
The same capability meaning can have different CLI, chat or other realizations.
A successful Define result cannot imply that an agent may repair production or close an incident.

plain_language.explanation: Define helps a person or agent work out the meaning the next task depends on. It finds what already exists, records proposed meanings, and keeps unanswered questions visible in a bundle that the next user can review.

domain_context.explanation: The Lab-owned CLI already reads selected Project State, Context Views and Ontology Views. This proposal defines the required capability outcome independently of that candidate implementation. Product ownership and runtime adoption remain separate integration work.
examples: For INC-1042, the goal is to clarify identifier coverage so missing rows can be investigated without modifying customer data.
A question about what counts as complete can remain open until its appropriate owner answers it.
Switching from a CLI wizard to an agent interface does not change the capability outcome or give a generated proposal admission authority.
